description: Mobile shopping flows wired to the real API: auth and session (phone/email OTP + email password, devCode only in dev builds, no Google, guest cart merge on login), onboarding wiring, home (home.sections + defaults), categories (3 levels), product listing (infinite scroll/sort/filters), debounced search + autocomplete + recent searches, product detail (variants/slabs/stock/PIN check/reviews/related, image viewer), cart (guest token, save for later, A8 move-to-cart, coupons) and wishlist (design §2.4, §6.4, §6.5, §11; plan.md items 17-20). Depends on FEAT-003 (api core, ui kit, navigation shell) and FEAT-002 (shared home defaults, formatInr).
steps: plan.md item 17: features/auth/{api.ts,hooks.ts,session.ts} with completeLogin per §6.4 (caller parses with mobileAuthResponseSchema first → ServerTooOld config error when refreshToken missing; tokenManager.setSession; session.setAuthenticated; queryClient.removeQueries(['cart']); merge with secure.peekGuestToken(), setQueryData(qk.cart('customer')), rotateGuestToken, deletePendingMerge; on failure setPendingMerge; invalidate wishlist/addresses/orders; adopt default address PIN), screens LoginScreen (tabs: Phone OTP only when extra.phoneOtpEnabled, Email OTP, Email & password; Terms/Privacy links), OtpVerifyScreen (OtpField, expiry countdown, resend after 30 s or 429 countdown, dev box 'Demo code (development build only)' only when extra.showDevOtp && devCode), RegisterScreen (emailRegisterSchema); success → navigation.dispatch(afterAuth(redirect)); logout wired through tokenManager.logout(). Test features/auth/__tests__/session.test.ts (4 §6.4 cases). Commit `feat(mobile): phone/email OTP and password sign-in with guest cart merge`.

plan.md item 18: features/home/{api.ts,hooks.ts,screens/HomeScreen.tsx,components/{HeroBanner,PromoGrid,WhyGrid,HomeBlocks,CategoryShortcuts}.tsx} per §11 Home (header with BelzoLogo, PIN chip/sheet validated by pincodeSchema + serviceability, bell badge for customers, fake SearchBar; banners or hero; category shortcuts; promos; rails from getHomeSections(settings.sections) with one query per rail and empty rails dropped; recently viewed rail; why grid; blocks; on request failure use mergeHome('emart', null) + DEFAULT_SECTIONS; pull-to-refresh; links through hrefToRoute). features/categories/{api.ts,hooks.ts,tree.ts,screens/CategoriesScreen.tsx} (two-pane L1 list / L2 headers + L3 chips; findBySlug). Test features/categories/__tests__/tree.test.ts.

plan.md item 19: features/products/{api.ts,hooks.ts,screens/{ProductListScreen,ProductDetailScreen,ImageViewerScreen}.tsx,components/{VariantPicker,SlabTable,DeliveryCheck,ReviewsList,Gallery}.tsx} per §11 (FlashList 2 two-column infinite scroll 20/page with footer states; sort sheet incl. page-local price caption; brand + category filter; slug-only category resolves via findBySlug; PDP variants by variantText, resolveSlabPrice live price, inStock text, QuantitySelector 1-99, DeliveryCheck states incl. configured=false, description/attributes/SHG story/not-returnable, reviews never showing customerId, related rail filtered, sticky Add to cart + Buy now (add then requireAuth(Checkout)), wishlist heart, recently-viewed push, 404 EmptyState; ImageViewer paging FlatList with page indicator, no pinch-zoom). features/search/{api.ts,hooks.ts,screens/SearchScreen.tsx} (autofocus, 250 ms autocomplete at ≥2 chars, 400 ms results infinite, recent searches with Clear, sort chips relevance/newest/popularity/rating, no category filter). Test features/search/__tests__/SearchScreen.test.tsx (mocked fetch, fake timers). Commit `feat(mobile): home, categories, product listing, search and product detail`.

plan.md item 20: features/cart/{api.ts,hooks.ts,screens/CartScreen.tsx,components/{CartLineRow,CouponBox}.tsx} per §6.5 (qk.cart(useCartIdentity()); add/PUT {variantId, quantity}/DELETE/save-for-later/POST /cart/items/:variantId/move-to-cart replace the cache; per-line QuantitySelector disabled while its mutation runs; unavailable/low-stock/out-of-stock states disable Checkout with reason; 500 → 'This item changed. Your cart has been refreshed.' + refetch; totals display-only; bulk-slab hint; CouponBox via requireAuth → POST /coupons/validate → useCheckoutDraft.couponCode; Items + Saved for later sections; sticky footer with Checkout via requireAuth; CartTab badge = active units). features/wishlist/{api.ts,hooks.ts,screens/WishlistScreen.tsx} (per-variant list, Add to cart keeps the item wishlisted, Remove, tap → PDP by slug). Test features/cart/__tests__/CartScreen.test.tsx. Replace the PlaceholderScreen registrations for every route this FEAT implements. Commit `feat(mobile): cart with guest token, save for later, move to cart, coupons and wishlist`.
acceptance_criteria: `pnpm --filter @belzo/mobile typecheck`, `lint`, `test` pass, including session.test.ts, tree.test.ts, SearchScreen.test.tsx and CartScreen.test.tsx
Every screen in this FEAT calls the real endpoints from design §4.1 through features/*/api.ts (no hard-coded data besides the shared home defaults)
The dev-code box renders only when extra.showDevOtp is true; no Google login UI exists
Authenticated cart requests never send x-guest-token (asserted in CartScreen or client tests)
verification: pnpm --filter @belzo/mobile typecheck; pnpm --filter @belzo/mobile lint; pnpm --filter @belzo/mobile test
findings: COMPLETED on Linux. Commits: 17b717b (auth: features/auth {api,session,hooks,screens Login/OtpVerify/Register} + session.test + AccountScreen; wired RootNavigator+MainTabs AccountTab); f8d89ff (home+categories: features/home {api,hooks,use-open-href,components HeroBanner/CategoryShortcuts/PromoGrid/WhyGrid/HomeBlocks/HomeRail/PincodeSheet,HomeScreen} + features/categories {api,hooks,tree,CategoriesScreen,tree.test}; wired HomeTab+CategoriesTab); d64c2c5 (products+search: features/products {api,hooks,screens ProductList/ProductDetail/ImageViewer, components VariantPicker/SlabTable/DeliveryCheck/ReviewsList/Gallery} + features/search {api,hooks,SearchScreen,SearchScreen.test} + MINIMAL cart/wishlist api+hooks; wired ProductList/ProductDetail/Search/ImageViewer); d8e9dc1 (cart+wishlist: extended cart api/hooks, CartLineRow/CouponBox/CartScreen/CartScreen.test, WishlistScreen; wired CartTab+Wishlist, removed PlaceholderScreen from MainTabs). Mobile green throughout: final 15 suites/140 tests, typecheck+lint pass. KEY LEARNINGS: FlashList rows don't render in jest (assert states/fetch, not rows); use real timers+findByText/waitFor for async (fake timers flaky); tests use globalThis.fetch; mock useNavigation via jest.mock('@react-navigation/native',()=>({...requireActual,useNavigation})) to avoid native-stack hang; cart requests auth:'optional'+cart:true (Bearer when authed else x-guest-token); coupon validate is auth:'required'; CartScreen hang on single-suite run is a benign jest open-handle (full suite force-exits workers & completes). PlaceholderScreen now only used by RootNavigator for not-yet-built FEAT-005 routes.
